topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Rain's been tapping at the window, like it's trying to tell me something. Met a guy today, newly moved into one of them old mansions. Found a hidden room, he did. Not just any closet, but a real sealed-off place. Covered in dust, smells of secrets and stale air. He's excited, thinks he's hit the jackpot, a mystery waiting to be solved. Me, I just nod, letting him talk. I know what's behind most doors, and it ain't always sunshine and lollipops. You dig enough, you find the dark corners. The ones that make you wish you'd left well enough alone. I tell him to be careful, that sometimes the past is best left buried. Watching him, all eager, I feel a knot in my gut, remembering the first time I pried open a door best left shut.
